desc: Ideation: identify that only O(B) entry/exit positions per good segment matter; choose segment-transition DP over the global critical DAG.

Implement the complete critical-position sweep DP end-to-end (merge intervals, candidate generation, bad filtering, direct recent buffer, internal reachability with A==B residue mask and A<B threshold, output Yes/No).
Verify on samples and edge cases: M=0, A=B, adjacent/merged bad blocks, bad block length >=B, N small, zero-length good gaps, and jumps skipping multiple bad blocks.
